pageProps.content: ## Overview of Ballerina Swan Lake Update 14 (2201.14.1) Swan Lake Update 14 (2201.14.1) is the first patch release of Ballerina 2201.14.0 (Swan Lake Update 14) and it includes a new set of bug fixes to the Ballerina library. ## Update Ballerina Run the command below to update your current Ballerina installation directly to 2201.14.1 by using the [Ballerina Update Tool](/learn/update-tool/). ``` $ bal dist pull 2201.14.1 ``` ## Install Ballerina If you have not installed Ballerina, then, download the [installers](/downloads/#swanlake) to install. ## Ballerina library updates ### Bug fixes The following Ballerina library packages are updated to versions that are aligned with Swan Lake Update 14 (2201.14.0) and Java 25. - `ballerina/graphql` - `1.19.0` - `ballerina/mcp` - `1.4.0` - Fixed the `KeyNotFound` panic that occurred when initializing an `mcp:StreamableHttpListener` or `mcp:Listener`. - Fixed an issue in which a defaultable tool parameter could not be omitted in a `tools/call` request ([#9143](https://github.com/ballerina-platform/ballerina-library/issues/9143)). - `ballerina/websub` - `2.16.0` - `ballerina/websubhub` - `1.17.0`
